bank_plan.formula: (lesson_check_items + module_check_items) x 2 alternates + forms x form_length
bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks, 3 practice forms and a protected final.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

mcq_limitation_note: Official test assesses writing and speaking; MCQ/MR cannot assess productive skills. Mastemy teaches all four skills by video and model-answer analysis but scores only receptive and knowledge items.

items.stem: A patient is 1 week post-op from a tissue repair. The therapist should progress resistance only when:

options.text: Tissue healing and protocol allow the added load
options.rationale: Correct: loading must respect healing timelines and the surgical protocol.

options.text: The patient asks to work harder
options.rationale: Patient preference does not override healing constraints.
Scheduling is unrelated to tissue tolerance.

options.text: Pain is completely absent at rest
options.rationale: Absence of rest pain alone does not confirm readiness for load.

items.explanation: Correct: loading must respect healing timelines and the surgical protocol.

items.stem: During exercise, a cardiac patient's response exceeds safe vital-sign limits. The therapist should:

options.text: Stop or modify the activity and reassess
options.rationale: Correct: patient safety requires halting or adjusting the activity.

options.text: Continue to reach the session goal
options.rationale: Pushing past safe limits risks harm.
Increasing intensity when limits are exceeded is unsafe.

options.text: Ignore the readings if the patient feels fine
options.rationale: Objective limits should not be ignored.

items.explanation: Correct: patient safety requires halting or adjusting the activity.
